chunks: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us from al-Abbas b. Ma'ruf from Ali b. Mahzayar from Fadala b. Ayyub from Aban b. Uthman from Muhammad b. Muslim from Abu Ja'far al-Baqir (peace be upon him). He said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) sent Khalid b. al-Walid to a neighbourhood called Banu al-Mustalaq from Bani Judhayma, and there had been a rivalry between them and Bani Makhzum during the Age of Ignorance. When he came upon them, they had already obeyed the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and had taken a letter from him. When Khalid came upon them, he ordered a caller to call to prayer, so he prayed and they prayed. When the Fajr prayer came, he ordered his caller to call, so he prayed and they prayed. Then he ordered the cavalry, and they launched a raid upon them, killing and wounding. They demanded their letter and found it, then they brought it to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and told him what Khalid b. al-Walid had done. So he faced the qibla and said: O Allah, I dissociate myself before You from what Khalid b. al-Walid has done.

He said: Then riches and goods were brought to the Messenger of Allah, and he said to Ali (peace be upon him): O Ali, go to Bani Judhayma from Banu al-Mustalaq and compensate them for what Khalid has done. Then he (peace be upon him and his family) raised his feet and said: O Ali, put the judgment of the people of Ignorance beneath your feet. So Ali (peace be upon him) went to them, and when he reached them, he judged among them by the judgment of Allah. When he returned to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), he said: O Ali, tell me what you have done.

He said: O Messenger of Allah, I went and gave blood money for every life, a servant for every unborn child, and wealth for every property. I had surplus remaining, so I gave them enough for their dogs' water bowls and their shepherds' ropes. I still had surplus remaining, so I gave them for the fright of their women and the terror of their children. I still had surplus remaining, so I gave them for what they know and what they do not know. I still had surplus remaining, so I gave them so that they would be pleased with you, O Messenger of Allah. So he (peace be upon him and his family) said: O Ali, you gave them so that they would be pleased with me. May Allah be pleased with you, O Ali. You are to me in the position of Aaron to Moses, except that there is no prophet after me.

key_terms.إحنة: Enmity/grudge - deep-seated hatred from the pre-Islamic era
key_terms.الجاهلية: The Age of Ignorance - the pre-Islamic period
key_terms.الغارة: Raid/attack - military assault on a group
key_terms.بمنزلة هارون من موسى: The Station of Aaron to Moses - the Hadith al-Manzila establishing Ali's unique position
key_terms.دية: Blood money - compensation for wrongful killing in Islamic law

ai.seo_question: What is the story of Khalid b. al-Walid attacking Banu al-Mustalaq and how did Imam Ali compensate them?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Baqir describes the incident where the Prophet sent Khalid b. al-Walid to Banu al-Mustalaq, who had already accepted Islam, but Khalid unjustly attacked them due to a pre-Islamic rivalry with Bani Makhzum. The Prophet disavowed Khalid's actions and sent Imam Ali to administer justice. Ali compensated them with extraordinary generosity — paying blood money, compensating for destroyed property, and going far beyond what was required until nothing remained except their complete satisfaction. The Prophet concluded by declaring Ali's station with the famous Hadith al-Manzila, comparing his relationship to that of Aaron and Moses.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us from al-`Abbas b. Ma`ruf from `Ali b. Mahzayar from Fadala b. Ayyub from Aban b. `Uthman from Muhammad b. Muslim from Abi Ja`far al-Baqir (as). He said:

The Messenger of Allah (s) sent Khalid b. al-Walid to a neighbourhood called Banu al-Mustalaq from Bani Judhayma, who had a rivalry with Bani Makhzum in Jahiliyya. When he was sent to them, they had followed the Messenger of Allah (s) and had taken letters from him [but they had yet to fully convert to Islam]. When Khalid was sent to them, he ordered a caller to call to prayer. He prayed and they prayed. When Fajr prayer came, he ordered his caller to call to prayer. So, he prayed and they prayed. Then, he called for a horse and started battling them. He killed and wounded [some of them]. They demanded their letter and they received it. It was given to the Prophet (s), and they had spoken about what Khalid b. al-Walid had done. So, he turned toward the qibla and said: O Allah! To You, I dissociate from what Khalid b. al-Walid has done.

He said: Then, the riches and the spoils were brought to the Messenger of Allah. So, he said to `Ali (as): O `Ali! Go to Bani Jadhima from Bani al-Mustalaq and rectify them from what Khalid has done. Then, he (s) raised his feet and said: O `Ali! Put the judgment of the people of Jahiliyya beneath your feet. So, `Ali (as) went to them. When he got to them, he judged them by the judgment of Allah. When he returned to the Prophet (s), he said: O `Ali! Inform me of what you have done.

So, he said: O Messenger of Allah! I gave blood money to everyone affected, a servant to every mother that miscarried, and money to everyone who was robbed. I had extra wealth, so I gave them containers to wash their dogs in and reins for their shepherds. I still had extra wealth, so I gave them until they could be pleased with you, O Messenger of Allah. So, he (s) said: O `Ali! You gave them so that they could be pleased with me. May Allah be pleased with you, O `Ali. You are to me as Aaron was to Moses, except there is no prophet after me.
